run_gtn_loss_example: run the pytorch GTN loss example to compute sequence criterion loss and gradients
create_target_graph: create a target graph from a token sequence where each token aligns to one or more frames
compute_gtn_forward_loss: compute the forward loss by intersecting target and emission graphs and scoring with GTN
compute_gtn_backward_gradients: compute backward gradients for GTN loss using parallel graph operations across the batch
use_gtn_loss_in_pytorch: use the GTNLoss function as a custom PyTorch autograd loss for frame-level to token-level sequence alignment
